sections.title: What You'll Learn: Solving Linear Equations
learning_goals: Define and identify pairs of linear equations in two variables.
Formulate linear equations from word problems.
Solve systems of linear equations using graphical, substitution, and elimination methods.
Understand the conditions for unique, no, and infinitely many solutions.
Apply these methods to real-world problems.
sections.renderer_reasoning: Standard summary section with avatar and bullet points for learning objectives.

sections.title: Understanding Pairs of Linear Equations
learning_goals: Define linear equations in two variables and their general form.
Explain what constitutes a 'pair' of linear equations.
Translate real-world scenarios into pairs of linear equations.
sections.renderer_reasoning: Manim is ideal for displaying equations, variables, and demonstrating the process of forming equations from word problems with visual aids.

sections.title: The Graphical Method: Visualizing Solutions
learning_goals: Understand how to represent linear equations graphically.
Identify the point of intersection as the solution to a system of equations.
Differentiate between intersecting, parallel, and coincident lines and their corresponding solution types.
sections.renderer_reasoning: Manim is excellent for plotting lines on a coordinate plane, highlighting intersection points, and illustrating parallel and coincident lines.

sections.title: Step-by-Step Graphical Solutions
learning_goals: Apply the graphical method to solve specific pairs of linear equations.
Interpret graphical results to determine unique, no, or infinitely many solutions.
sections.renderer_reasoning: Manim can animate the plotting of points and lines, making the step-by-step graphical solution process clear and engaging.

sections.title: Algebraic Methods: Substitution and Elimination
learning_goals: Master the substitution method for solving pairs of linear equations.
Master the elimination method for solving pairs of linear equations.
Choose the most appropriate algebraic method for different problem types.
sections.renderer_reasoning: Manim is ideal for demonstrating algebraic manipulations, showing step-by-step calculations for both substitution and elimination methods.

sections.title: Advanced Concepts: Conditions for Solutions
learning_goals: Understand the conditions (ratios of coefficients) that determine the nature of solutions (unique, no, infinitely many).
Apply these conditions to solve problems involving unknown coefficients (e.g., finding 'k').
sections.renderer_reasoning: Manim can clearly present the mathematical conditions and animate the comparison of coefficients to explain the different solution types.
